images.alt: Vogue digital cover on off-white, with a serif Archive & Horizons headline over a warm-toned photo of three models reclining together and a small black-and-white portrait of a man reading a magazine.

Editorial spread with an enormous serif 1961 numeral, a black-and-white portrait of a face behind tulle, justified body copy on intentional fashion, and a cropped color detail of leopard print and jewelry.

Closing spread with two warm golden-hour portraits of a model holding a Vogue issue, an oversized lowercase vogue wordmark, body copy on silhouette and color, and a city index: Paris, New York, Milan, Tokyo, London.
